title: Regenerate bindings and golden fixtures

redGate.reason: FND-012 regenerates existing generators over new inputs. The property under test is determinism and cross-language parity, not new behaviour.
proofPlan: Verify the vendored native generator before generating.
Generate, then generate again and compare the emitted tree byte for byte.
Run the cross-language lane including the native generator artifact tests.

Add golden hash vectors for the catalog hash, the version two request hash, the consent binding, stream event decoding, and the version two receipt hash, and bump the hardcoded vector count in the .NET parity test.

goldenVectors.reason: The three required vectors are quoted from external reference note 99 section 14.2 and must keep their hand-checked hashes. The five new vectors are repository-derived and are computed by canonicalHash at generation time, which is what the existing two supplemental vectors already do. All ten are iterated by the .NET and Rust parity tests.

added.name: model-catalog-hash
added.value: The model catalog fixture with catalogHash removed, which is the projection the catalog epoch is computed over.

added.name: model-access-request-v2-hash
added.value: The complete version two request fixture including its consent decision, items, and tools.

added.name: model-context-consent-v2-binding
added.value: The nine fields that bind a version two consent decision to a request: decision, request, profile, catalog epoch, requested variant, request mode, context snapshot, and canonical output schema id and hash.

added.name: model-stream-event-decoding
added.value: The completed stream event with its safe receipt summary, so all three languages agree on how a decoded event canonicalizes.

added.name: model-access-receipt-v2-hash
added.value: The version two receipt with receiptHash and proof removed, which is the signed payload projection.

countLiteral.note: The assertion counts required plus supplemental. The Rust equivalents in tests/generator-qualification/rust/tests/qualification.rs and crates/desktop-runtime/src/hash.rs iterate without a count literal and needed no change.

determinism.method: The literal plan command `git diff --exit-code -- packages/contracts/generated` cannot prove determinism here, because the working tree is intentionally uncommitted: it returns 1 against HEAD for the five new families regardless of whether generation is deterministic. The equivalent proof was run instead.
proof: Hashed every file under packages/contracts/generated into a sorted path-and-digest tree.
Hashed the tree again and compared.
determinism.generatorInternalGuard: generate.mjs additionally double-runs the TypeScript and native generators into separate clean staging roots and raises CONTRACT_GENERATOR_NONDETERMINISTIC on any difference before writing.
